description: Generate an instrumental music track (no vocals) for a game: an MP3 of 30-120 seconds saved as a music asset in the user's Voidless library. For a single short sound (a hit, a pickup, a click) use generate_sfx instead. 10 credits on every call, whatever the length (each call makes and bills a new track; refunded if it fails); a slow run returns a job for check_generation. Returns the asset ID, the MP3 link and the credits left. For free game music made at once (ten styles, 8-bit or high quality, seamless loops and stingers, as WAV and MIDI), use compose_music.

bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute, 80-200 (default 100): about 80-100 for calm or exploration music, 120-160 for action or chases

duration.description: Track length in seconds, 30-120 (default 60). The price does not change with length

keyScale.description: Musical key and scale, e.g. 'A minor', 'D major' (default 'C major'). Minor keys sound darker or tenser, major keys brighter

prompt.description: 10-300 characters naming the genre, mood, instruments and where it plays, e.g. 'upbeat chiptune with square-wave lead for a title screen'. Leave tempo and key to bpm and keyScale, which are added to the prompt

name: generate_music
